## Prior-resolution disposition

The exact complex-algebraic supergroup containment conjecture is resolved by the 2024 SSV Sylow-theory preprint, with published 2026 group-level corroboration.

The certificate identifies the actual standard block subgroup SL(1|1)^n, checks its global form, proves the inside-K minimality step using both directions of splitting transitivity, and accounts for disconnected K and n = 0.

This is an exact-source applicability and implication certificate. It is conditional on the cited prior theorem in the ordinary literature-resolution sense; it is not an independent validation of each entire preprint, a new proof, a novelty claim, formal verification, or human peer review.

## Contents and verification

- Eight addition-only files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004886/`: complete authored certificate, source ledger, sanitized raw-PDF metadata, acceptance/status, edition guide and payload manifest.
- The mathematical certificate’s substantive argument is preserved; editorial changes remove workflow wording and, where present, replace a short literal source quotation with an authored mathematical formulation.
- All selected public-PDF byte counts and SHA-256 hashes were independently rechecked against the original source audit records. No new full-PDF download, publisher-text inspection or whole-manuscript audit is claimed.
- Payload manifest, exact file allowlist, local links, UTF-8/JSON and clean temporary addition-only replay passed local verification. These checks establish packaging integrity, not a hosted-CI pass.
- Zero proof-search approaches and zero proof turns. No `QUEUE.md` or unrelated repository changes.

Payload manifest SHA-256: `469428c97377cc5836d071334217887e47fd15e5fef9686134f86779e6986d94`.
